text:
leo_security: Proposal: create a time-limited SIEM export token + PII-scrub pipeline for exports (target: PCI/HIPAA). Add new RBAC role "siem_exporter_readonly", enforce KMS-wrapped export keys, and automated rotation on suspicion. Also update retention policy to TTL=90 days for raw logs, exports only with explicit approval.

jamie_eng: +1. Question: how do we enforce token TTL across on-prem and hosted? can we issue short-lived JWTs via our auth service?

maria_ops: Need audit trail for every export (who/why). Also need update to retention docs. Link to runbook: https://go/runbooks/siem-exports

alex_sec: For KMS: prefer envelope encryption with HSM-wrapped DEKs. We should require key policy that denies GetPlaintext except to kms-proxy. Also rotation playbook: rotate DEKs + rewrap DEK with new KEK, revoke previous tokens.

sara_sre: Implementation idea: airflow DAG to run PII-scrub and sign manifest. Pseudocode:
```
# scrub job
scrub --input s3://logs/raw --rules /etc/scrub/rules.yaml --output s3://logs/exports/cleaned
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/siem-export-keK --plaintext file://deks
```

chris_secops: Urgent: we just got a vuln report that an old export key (rotated in prod months ago) was included in a support bundle. We need immediate revocation for that KEK and re-issue for affected tenants. I'll open an incident ticket.

audit-bot: New ticket created: SIEM-EXPORT-2026-01 - "support bundle leak" - assigned chris_secops, severity P2

leo_security: Ok, action items: (1) chris: lead emergency rotation for leaked key; (2) alex: write key policy and KMS proxy changes; (3) jamie & sara: prototype TTL token + DAG scrub; (4) maria: update runbook & retention docs + make export approval workflow. Can we aim for a canary deploy next week?

jamie_eng: I'll try to get a PoC for TTL JWTs by Tue. Question: should tokens be single-use or sliding window?

alex_sec: Single-use + short TTL (5m) + refresh via audit-backed exchange. Single-use prevents replay; heavy ops but safer.

maria_ops: Approval workflow: require 2 approvers for PCI exports, automated email + slack webhook. Also add mandatory justification field.

sara_sre: For large customers, we might need streaming scrub instead of batch. Let's note perf limits: scrub job adds ~12-25% CPU and increases latency for exports.

leo_security: Thanks. chris, when you open the incident, include a list of affected keys/tenants and we will do communication draft. :eyes:

chris_secops: On it. drafting comms now. Will post updates here. :lock:

deploy-bot: scheduled: key-rotation-job (canary) -> Tue 03:00UTC
